text: Chapter 13: The Water Tribe and Coenubia@Underwater Inhabitants
■Next Mission\nStart from Erva Tronc: Leader's House.
The leader asked you to accompany Muti to join forces with\nthe Ranas and those who are against Coenubias. First, go to\nFugitive Lake Swamp where a small group of Ranas lives!
You reached Labrum Atoll after receiving Rana's Bangle,\nhowever you cannot get under the water.\nFind the entrance and head toward the Puerta Islands!
You have arrived in the Puerta Islands, but it turns out to\nbe a place inhabited by underwater monsters.\nProceed carefully further into the depths!
After finally finding what appears to be the entrance,\nyou show the bangle to Zapo, the guard, but he doesn't\ntrust you. Defeat Zapo to prove your strength!
